title: Quezon City Waste Generation per Barangay Reference Data (WACS 2021)
publisher: Quezon City Task Force on Solid Waste Management (TFSWM) & EPWMD
epidemiological_relevance: Solid waste accumulation and discarded containers (plastics, tin cans, food wrappers, tires) provide prime artificial container breeding habitats for Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. High waste generation density (kg/ha/day) represents an environmental sanitation risk factor targeted under the DOH 4S Strategy (Search and Destroy).
